text:
kenji: Heads-up — new nimble-q5a shadow bring-up shows two separate locale regressions: 1) CJK mixed-line subtitle samples (ja+zh+kr) get kana fused into adjacent han clusters during detok, 2) Arabic/RTL lines have bracket mirroring flipped after quant detok, breaking downstream SRT timestamps. Both observed only in q5a shadows, float baseline is fine.

yara: Oof. Can you paste minimal repros and tokenizer config?

kenji: Repro pair (original utf8):
```
input: "東京の地下鉄で 친구를 만났어요. (مرحبا)"  # ja + kr + ar mix
float detok: "東京の地下鉄で 친구를 만났어요. (مرحبا)"
q5a detok:  "東京の地下鉄で친구를 만났어요.(مرحبا)"
```
Problems: 1) missing space between han run and hangul -> subtitle timing + alignment break. 2) Arabic parentheses become mirrored in output for some lines: e.g. float "(مرحبا)" -> q5a ")مرحبا(" in raw detok.

micah: That's interesting: two different detok failure modes. Tokenizer heuristics could cause the CJK+hangul join, while RTL shaping/mirroring issues usually happen at render/detok time. What tokenizer version/config?

zhang: quant pipeline: nimble-v2 float -> quantize(q5a symmetric-per-row) -> pack. Tokenizer: redwood-tokenizer@v2.15, preserve_zwj=false, locale_hint unset (we rely on auto-detect). We added a tiny whitespace-normalize pass in v2.15 that tries to be aggressive around mixed-script boundaries.

yara: can we confirm token counts? If token count drops that's tokenizer. If counts match but detok chars flip, that's post-tokenization mapping or detok logic.

kenji: token counts for that sentence: float tokens=22, q5a tokens=19. So tokenization reduced tokens. Also detok char order swapped for arabic in some q5a outputs.

micah: two-prong repro plan: 1) tokenizer-only diff v2.14->v2.15 on a 2k mixed set, 2) detok-only run (take token sequences from q5a and run detok routine from float runtime vs quant runtime) to isolate if detok stage diverged. I'll run them.

(eval-bot): tokenizer-smoke (mix_ja_kr_zh_ar_2k) 2026-10-05T14:04Z:
- v2.14 avg tokens/sent: 20.9
- v2.15 avg tokens/sent: 19.2
- pct sentences with token-count drop >=2: 9.7%
- p-value paired: 0.008

micah: tokenizer diff looks suspicious. zhang, that whitespace-normalize pass in v2.15 — can you show the rule?

zhang: rule: collapse_adjacent_monospace=false; normalize_mixed_script_edges=true; also added: "treat_small_hiragana_as_joiner=true" for perf reasons. I suspect that last flag.

yara: i'll flip that flag locally and run a 200-sample BLEU check on subtitle devset.

(ops-bot): queued job: run-subtitle-bleu (nimble-q5a-shadow) after tokenizer flip. ETA ~20m.

micah: regarding RTL bracket mirroring — detok uses unicode-bidi + mirroring table. If tokenization reduced tokens around parens then bidi context may change and mirroring can flip. Need to compare raw codepoint sequences pre- and post-detok.

kenji: I extracted raw token id sequences from float and q5a for one failing example. They differ in token boundaries around the parenthesis region. That suggests tokenization change cascaded into bidi context shift.

yara: run results: with `treat_small_hiragana_as_joiner=false` patched in v2.15 local build -> avg tokens restored (20.7), sample BLEU float=34.1, q5a+patched=33.2 (previous q5a=29.6). Big win.

(eval-bot): adhoc-run nimble-q5a-shadow vs nimble-float on subtitle-mini (n=200):
- BLEU float: 34.1
- BLEU q5a (v2.15 raw): 29.6
- BLEU q5a (v2.15 patched joiner=false): 33.2
- detok-checksum float: 0x1a2b3c4d
- detok-checksum q5a/raw: 0x7f6e5d4c
- detok-checksum q5a/patched: 0x1a2b3c49

micah: confirms root cause: tokenizer heuristic change in v2.15 caused token boundary shifts, which cascaded into bidi mirror changes and subtitle misalignment. Quant itself only added a small residual BLEU gap.

zhang: opened PR #5020 to revert `treat_small_hiragana_as_joiner` default and add mixed-script subtitle tests (ja-kr-zh-ar combos). Also adding a detok parity check into the bring-up pipeline: after quant shadow build, compare detok checksum Hamming distance against float; if > 16 block.

kenji: thanks. action items: 1) block nimble-q5a shadow rollout that bundles redwood-tokenizer@v2.15 until PR merges (yara/ops), 2) add locale-aware token-count gating to model bring-up checklist (suzanne?), 3) run embedding-index parity check post-rebuild to ensure no index aliasing (micah).

yara: ops blocked the rollout. PR #5020 in review. I'll add the mixed subtitle vectors to the smoke harness and a short note in onboarding docs about locale_hint pitfalls.

kenji: good triage. Let's also add a short postmortem blurb linking to the PR and the smoke logs so on-call can reference. Lowering severity to P2 while blocked. :thumbsup:
